items.title: Pacers officially signed forward Jalen Slawson to a two-way contract.
items.author: Scott Agness
items.body_excerpt:
Pacers officially signed forward Jalen Slawson to a two-way contract.

Also on one: Kobe Brown and Ethan Thompson.

Rookie Braden Smith remains unsigned.
